name: Tinker: Macro-Gravity Zone snares, stacks and stuns
contract: #452: Macro-Gravity Zone (707104) is two ordinary persistent area auras - a -50% snare with mechanic 11 and a 500 ms periodic trigger of Macro-Gravity (712289) - so the zone itself needs no script. The only scripted part, the six-stack payoff, already lives on the triggered spell: aura_ascension_tinker_lifecycle casts Macro-Gravity stun (712319) at six stacks, which triggers the Gravity-Adjusted marker (712401). An enemy standing in the zone must be snared by 50%, must gather Macro-Gravity stacks, and must end up stunned and marked.

steps.label: The zone's ground effect is out
The zone's snare effect on the enemy is -50
The enemy is actually slowed to half speed
Macro-Gravity stacks on the enemy inside the zone
The six-stack payoff stuns the enemy
The stun marks the enemy as Gravity-Adjusted
